label: Statewide Amendment 1
t: Elect lieutenant governor to fill vacancies
what: Today a vacancy in the lieutenant governor's office stays open until the next regular election. This amendment requires an election to fill the rest of the term if the office becomes vacant more than 60 days before the next general election for state officers. It also lets the Legislature set the pay of the lieutenant governor and legislative officers by joint resolution, and requires legislators' travel spending to be approved by an officer elected by their chamber.
y: A vacant lieutenant governor's office would be filled by election, and the Legislature could set these officers' pay by joint resolution.
n: The office stays vacant until the next regular election and pay stays set in the Constitution.
fiscal: Fair Ballot Commission: there are no costs or taxes associated with Amendment 1.

label: Statewide Amendment 2
t: Allow neighboring county school systems to merge
what: Creates a process for two or more neighboring county boards of education to merge into one multi-county school system by resolution. The State Board of Education must first study and publish the effects on students, families, programs, transportation, finances and taxes. If 25% of qualified voters in any affected system protest, the merger needs approval by a majority in each county and overall at the next general election.
y: Neighboring county school boards could merge their systems through this process.
n: The Constitution keeps no process for merging county school systems.
fiscal: Fair Ballot Commission: there are no costs or taxes associated with Amendment 2.

label: Statewide Amendment 3
t: Daily Pledge and student-led prayer in schools
what: Requires every local school board to adopt a policy for each public K-12 school to conduct the Pledge of Allegiance at the start of each school day. It also requires a policy allowing student-initiated, student-led prayer. No student can be required to take part, and students may opt out of either based on their beliefs.
y: Schools must hold the Pledge daily and boards must allow student-led prayer, with an opt-out.
n: The Constitution does not require these policies.
fiscal: Fair Ballot Commission: there are no costs or taxes associated with Amendment 3.

label: Statewide Amendment 4
t: Weekly national anthem in public schools
what: Requires every local school board to adopt a policy for each public K-12 school to broadcast the first stanza of The Star-Spangled Banner at least once a week during school hours. A board may instead allow a school-approved band, choir or vocalist to perform it, using the Library of Congress version.
y: Public schools must play or perform the anthem at least weekly.
fiscal: Fair Ballot Commission: there are no costs or taxes associated with Amendment 4.
